item.title: Molly: An Improved Signal App
item.description:
📝 An improved Signal app Get Molly Molly is an independent Signal fork for Android with improved features: Fully FOSS Contains no proprietary blobs, unlike Signal Encrypted Protects database with Passphrase Encryption Multi-Device Pair multiple devices to a single account Material You Extra theme that follows your device palette UnifiedPush Ungoogled notification system Automatic Locking When you are gone for a set period of time RAM Shredding Securely shreds sensitive data torbrowser Tor Support Supports SOCKS proxy and Tor via Orbot And more New and better features to come Download Molly github [#142] Donate.
🔗 Read more: https://molly.im/

item.title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents
item.description:
📝 We developed a two-fold solution to enable the Claude Agent SDK to work effectively across many context windows: an initializer agent that sets up the environment on the first run, and a coding agent that is tasked with making incremental progress in every session, while leaving clear artifacts for the next session. This happens even with compaction, which doesn’t always pass perfectly clear instructions to the next agent. ” This “different prompt” requests that the initializer agent set up the environment with all the necessary context that future coding agents will need to work effectively.
🔗 Read more: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents
